basic_info.description: Classic Sunnyside gem blending original charm with modern updates. Fully detached and move-in ready, this spacious 2-level home offers 4 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. The main level features a generous, bright living room with bay windows, custom built-ins, and an original brick fireplace. Formal dining room flows into the updated eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances. 2 generously sized bedrooms and a classic split bath complete this floor. The primary bedroom has direct access to a large rear deck providing indoor-outdoor living. Lower level includes 2 additional bedrooms, a full bath with tub, family room/office, and a versatile laundry room. A spiral staircase connects both levels maximizing space efficiency. The 1-car garage includes internal access, multiple storage areas and additional driveway parking. Beautifully landscaped backyard with mature fruit trees and ample space to garden or entertain. Close to Glen Park, West Portal, public transportation, parks, schools, shops and restaurants, and easy access to freeways.
